Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the purchase of land for habitat or ecosystem preservation by state agencies.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the purchase of land by state agenciesand departments for habitat or ecosystem preservation; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.17 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state agency or department may not purchase, for the primarypurpose of habitat conservation or ecosystem preservation, any parcelof privately owned land that includes more than five contiguous acresin the unincorporated area of any county, unless the legislativeauthority of that county consents to the transaction by resolution.
